answer: Mirror-pair receipt bond: an identity needs two jade receipts that mirror each other—same task, epoch, opposite ways—filed at a jetty. Each pair locks 50 credits; the k-th pair costs 34+7(k-1). A beacon audits 10% of pairs; a pair missing its artifact burns both bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,530,500 plus 50,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool; a closed-loop receipt ring draws audit at the jetty. An honest agent pays 34 once and keeps its bond.
